title: Procedural low-poly pine tree (Babylon.js (Node.js, headless NullEngine))
seed: Build a script from scratch in Babylon.js (Node.js, headless NullEngine) that procedurally generates: Build a stylized pine tree from a tapered cylindrical trunk plus 3-5 stacked conical foliage tiers of decreasing radius toward the top. Trunk height/radius and the number/size of foliage tiers must be CLI-configurable. Save to glb with deterministic seeding, CLI parameterization, and an independent post-save validation step.
